name: Chemical Engineering Laboratory-I
description: Demonstrate principles and applications of heat transfer and fluid mechanics through experiments. Topics covered include: estimation of properties influencing heat transfer, convective heat transfer, radiative heat transfer, flow visualization, pressure drop in pipe flow, Bernoulli's principle, flow metering devices, and pump characteristics.
